text: Hong Kong will require covered crypto providers to collect customer transaction information starting in 2027. The tax department begins international information exchanges under CARF in 2028. via CryptoSlate #HongKong #Crypto

Crypto liquidations totaled $974.8M over 24 hours as bitcoin rose 4.6% to $80,480. Most losses hit traders betting on declines, per Coinglass. via BeInCrypto #Bitcoin #Crypto

Amundi, Europe's largest asset manager, has tokenized an equity index fund on Ethereum. The new share class gives blockchain-based exposure to an index covering 600 companies across European markets. via Cointelegraph #Ethereum #RWA

Ripple-backed XRP treasury firm Evernorth has dropped nearly 47% since its October Nasdaq listing. A new filing shows 73.7 million shares holders could resell, raising concerns about selling pressure. via BeInCrypto #XRP #Crypto

Thailand's SEC has filed a criminal complaint against BG Limited, operator of Bitget, over alleged unlicensed trading from 2022 to 2025. A planned access block is set for Dec 5. via Bitcoin Magazine #Bitget #Thailand
